newsitem.title: USA: UST extends stock buy back program.
newsitem.headline: UST extends stock buy back program.

text.p: UST Inc said Monday directors extended the company's stock buyback program, approving a new repurchase program which authorizes the purchase of up to 20 million common shares from time to time in open market or negotiated transactions for use in connection with benefit and compensation plans and other corporate purposes.

The company also said it intends to borrow an additional $100 million to augment its share repurchase program for the remainder of 1996 through 1997. Future cash requirements and market conditions will determine the actual amounts utilized.

The new program will commence upon the completion of the company's current program, which provides for the repurchase of up to 20 million shares and has been in effect since June 22, 1994. To date, the company said, it has repurchased 18.8 million shares under this program.
